content.text:
EP3477840 is a University of Maribor welding transformer patent (filed October 2018, granted May 2020, Slovenian priority SI25535A). Two families cite it, and in both cases the examiner cited it as a primary reference against the independent claims.

**Robert Bosch GmbH, EP3796345A1 and its Chinese counterpart CN112530684 (granted as B)**
This is a welding transformer with modular secondary windings, each module carrying a mounting unit for a rectifier. Same inventor country as the cited patent (Slovenia). In the EP search report the examiner cited EP3477840A1 as category X against claim 1, pointing to the abstract and figure 2. Category X means the examiner held it to anticipate the claim on its own. The CN citation is the same search-report citation carried into the Chinese member.

**Siemens AG, EP4726980A1, published April 2026**
This is a resonant converter with a split secondary winding on either side of the primary, a center-tap rectifier, and an overvoltage dissipation unit. The examiner cited EP3477840B1 as category I against all claims 1 to 12, pointing to paragraphs 31 to 40 and figures 1 and 6. Category I on an EP search report marks a document the examiner considers of particular relevance, used here as the main starting point alongside US2018197673A1. This citation is too recent to appear in the PATSTAT Spring 2026 edition, so only EPO OPS reports it.

Neither citation is an applicant citation and there are no opposition citations. The PATSTAT graph shows no other citing families.
